description.zh: 本次读取的最大数据量，默认值为20
description.en: The maximum number of entries returned. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 用来表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕, 第一次查询不需要提供这个参数
description.en: The cursor for pagination. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. When the returned value is empty, all data has been retrieved.

description.en: The name of the notification policy. Supports fuzzy matching.
